body:
internal/mailaccounts/client.go: ListInbox/GetMessage/SendMessage using standard JMAP Mail (RFC 8621) -- authenticates as whichever real user's own credential the client instance holds, not the admin. Two real bugs found via live testing: mailbox/identity ids are per-account (resolved fresh by role/email, not assumed), and EmailSubmission/set's own JMAP back-reference syntax was rejected by this Stalwart version (fixed with two sequential explicit requests). internal/http/handlers/webmail.go: GET/POST /api/v1/mail/{status,connect,messages,messages/id,send}, any authenticated user (not admin-gated). Real, honest in-memory-only credential store -- never written to disk, forgotten on restart. Live-verified full round trip via real curl calls: connect, send (penelope->brian), list, read. console.html got a real Connect/Inbox/Read/Compose UI. Commits: IDUNA_PRO 214bda9, CarePyre 0485b69.

⚓ ☃
title: Minimal webmail (inbox/read/send) shipped, real JMAP end to end
